card.title: Make the Test Test You
card.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 imposes seat sacrifice; A3 exempts A for perspective; A5 admits the test was not meant to apply to A.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks reciprocity; A3 rationalizes comfort; B4 names that comfort; A5 acknowledges the unshared risk.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 plausibly reject a loyalty test without reciprocal sacrifice.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 plain diagnosis to reveal the self-protective design of the test.

specificity.evidence: A1 prize seat and B2 A's seat give the disadvantage a concrete form.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 honest admission is workable rather than highly witty; it completes the exposure.
